study type: Observational laboratory study & Descriptive observational retrospective analysis
exposure: Presence of motor proteins in fallopian tube cilia
outcome: Motor protein composition of human fallopian tube cilia
Fertility outcomes in women with PCD
cohort: Human fallopian tube specimens from 5 healthy females & 9 females with PCD from a clinical database
finding: Although the motor protein composition and function of human fallopian tube cilia are similar to that of respiratory cilia, women with PCD, a disease characterized by dysfunction of motile cilia and flagella, are not necessarily infertile.
